properties.rationale: Standing disposition for planned-but-unbuilt capabilities (user's 2026-07-23 call, applied again 2026-07-24). Naming the check now, because this one has an unusually good fixture available: reflow2's own graph. When built, the verification should assert that requirements demonstrably shipped — invoked over MCP, persists in-repo, runs on Linux and macOS — come back DELIVERED without anyone having hand-set a status, and that a requirement whose satisfying capability has a failing check does NOT. The second half is the real test: today ver:search-natural-language is failing, so cap:search must not read as delivered, and req:agent-native must reflect that. A derivation that cannot go backwards is just a slower assertion.
